verdict.rationale: Secureframe's Comply AI generates in-product suggestions from customer data. It produces inherent and residual risk scores, treatment plans and justifications from risk descriptions, auto-generates infrastructure-as-code fixes, extracts answers from vendor documents, and generates SSPs and POA&Ms that reflect real-time compliance data. missing for 10: a general in-app AI insights or Q&A layer across all workspace data (the MCP server only offers this through external assistants), detailed documentation of how insights are surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
